ImpressoIssue.description: Logical representation of the contents of a canonical issue (newspaper or broadcast).

cdt.description: Creation date timestamp (of the JSON file).

consolidated.description: True if this issue is consolidated, and contains additional language identification and ocrqa information.

consolidated_ts_original.description: Creation date timestamp (in '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' format) of the original issue which was consolidated into this object. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

i.description: The content item(s) contained in the newspaper/radio_broadcast issue. Upstream places required m on the array, where JSON Schema does not apply it; the entry metadata is therefore optional.

id.description: Canonical ID of the newspaper or radio broadcast issue (e.g. GDL-1900-01-02-a, or SOC_CJ-1940-07-22-a)

iiif_manifest_uri.description: URI for the issue's manifest in the IIIF Presentation API. The field is present only when a meaningful URI is available.

is_exact_date.description: False if the date assigned to the issue is known to be inexact or approximated, True or undefined otherwise.

media_title_variant.description: Variant title of the media title this CI is from (mainly in the case of BL newspapers). The field is present only when a meaningful variant title is available.

olr.description: True if optical layout recognition was applied to the issue/bulletin this content item originates from.

pp.description: Canonical IDs of pages in the issue, without file extension (e.g. GDL-1900-01-02-a-p0004). In the case `sm` is in [`print`, `typescript`].

provided_metadata.description: Minimally preprocessed issue-level metadata included by the provider institution, especially useful for radio data (sm=audio).

rc.description: Radio channel, if applicable (st=='radio_broadcast'). The field is present only when a meaningful value is available.

rp.description: Radio program if applicable (st=='radio_broadcast'). The field is present only when a meaningful program name is available.

rr.description: Canonical ID of audio record of the issue (in list for consistency), without file extension (e.g. INA-1900-01-02-a-r0004). In the case `sm`==`audio`.

s.description:
The text style as defined in the OCR output. 
Each style consists of:
 - a name (`id`)
 - a type-face (`f`)
 - a font-size (`fs`)
 - a color (`rgb`).

sm.description: Source medium, format in which the media was originally produced. If `tp == radio_broadcast`, this is typically `typescript` or `audio`.

st.description: Type of media source. Should be a value the impresso-essentials.utils SourceType enum.

ts.description: Creation date timestamp (in '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' format). If consolidated==True, this is the consolidated timestamp (the original creation timestamp can be found in consolidated_timestamp_original); otherwise it is the original creation timestamp.

ImpressoIssue.title: ImpressoIssue

ImpressoIssueItem.description: A content item (e.g. article, advertisement, radio broadcast, etc.)

c.description: Coordinates (xywh format or [HPOS, VPOS, WIDTH, HEIGHT]) of image-region corresponding to the content-item depending on its type (if `tp == image`). NOTE: the 'null' option should be removed to prevent tables from having coordinates.

l.description: Legacy sections or components of the content item in the original OCR/OLR. They are meant to enable the reassignation of Impresso CIs (and enrichments) to the original OCR/OLR files.

pOf.description: Article/content-item to which the image is attached (if `tp == image`).

section_title.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.

ImpressoIssueItem.title: ImpressoIssueItem

ImpressoIssueSection.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.

composing_ci_ids.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.composing_ci_ids.

heading_legacy_parts.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.heading_legacy_parts.

section_id.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.section_id.

title_text.description: A section title grouping content items, with its original OCR components.title_text.

ImpressoIssueSection.title: ImpressoIssueSection

ImpressoLegacy.description: Legacy sections or components of the content item in the original OCR/OLR. They are meant to enable the reassignation of Impresso CIs (and enrichments) to the original OCR/OLR files.

id.description: ID of the sections or components used to compose the CI in the original OCR/OLR files.

parts.description: List of parts of the given section or components. Exact contents can vary, will typically be composed of the metadata at disposal in the OCR/OLR.

source.description: Source image or OCR/OLR file name.

ImpressoLegacy.title: ImpressoLegacy

ImpressoLegacyPart.description: One original OCR component retained for tracing a content item back to its source.

comp_fileid.description: ID of the ALTO file the component comes from.

comp_role.description: Role of the component part (eg. heading, body, etc).

ImpressoLegacyPart.title: ImpressoLegacyPart

ImpressoMetadata.description: Metadata for an entry in the canonical issue, including its page or audio references.

archival_note.description: Plaintext archival note or description concerning the content item. In case of audio radio broadcasts, this corresponds to the content summary provided with the metadata. The field is present only when a meaningful note is available.

consolidated_char_len.description: Character count of the consolidated text for the content item. May be null if there is no text. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

consolidated_langident_run_id.description: Run ID corresponding to the lang ID process used to obtain the `consolidated_language` value. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

consolidated_lg.description: Computed language of the content item. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

consolidated_ocrqa.description: Estimated OCR quality, between 0 and 1. May be null if there is no text or not enough text to compute an estimate. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

consolidated_reocr_applied.description: True if the CI's text went through the re-OCRisation process. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

consolidated_reocr_model_id.description: Model ID or name corresponding to the re-OCR process. Only defined if `consolidated==True` and `consolidated_re_ocr_applied==True`.

consolidated_reocr_run_id.description: Run ID corresponding to the re-OCR process. Only defined if `consolidated==True` and `consolidated_re_ocr_applied==True`.

iiif_link.description: IIIF image link, depending on content item type (if `tp == image`). The field is present only when a meaningful link is available. It should follow the format: '{scheme}://{server}/{prefix}/{identifier}/info.json'.

lg_original.description: Language of the content item in the original OCR/OLR. Only defined if `consolidated==True`.

pp.description: Page numbers over which the content item spans, in the case `sm` is in [`print`, `typescript`].

ro.description: Reading order index of the content item, for the table of contents view on the interface. If not defined, the CI number (after 'i' in the ID) should be used.

rr.description: Record numbers over which the content item spans, in the case `sm` is `audio`.

speakers.description: List of speakers (names or IDs based on availabilities) within boradcast.

t.description: Title of the content item. The field is present only when a meaningful title is available.

var_t.description: Deprecated, replaced by `media_title_variant` at issue's top-level. Variant title of the media title this CI is from (only in the case of BL newspapers). The field is present only when a meaningful variant title is available.

ImpressoMetadata.title: ImpressoMetadata

ImpressoStyle.description: One text style from the original OCR, identified locally within the issue.
